Let me think about this differently. The vulnerability description says "heap-double-free in opt_cleanup". Let me look at the `intern_blocks` function more carefully. It modifies `JT(p)` and `JF(p)` pointers. After `intern_blocks`, some blocks might have their `JT`/`JF` pointing to the same block. But that shouldn't cause a double-free in `opt_cleanup` since `opt_cleanup` only frees the arrays, not the blocks themselves.
